user_reported_bug:
Bug: Self-heal retry counter UI mein stale hai
Location: Loop status bar → "heal X/2" chip (bottom-right of loop progress bar, near VERIFY step)
Steps to reproduce:
1. Loop run jisme VERIFY step fail ho aur self-heal trigger ho
2. Chat log mein multiple 'Verify failed after 2 attempts' events aa rahe hain (4+ dikhe is run mein)
3. Lekin 'heal X/2' chip hamesha 'heal 1/2' pe stuck reh raha hai, chahe backend mein actual retry count usse zyada ho chuka ho
Expected: Chip ka number backend ke actual current self-heal attempt count ke saath live sync hona chahiye (1/2, phir 2/2, etc.)
Actual: Chip UI state backend event stream se desync ho raha hai — shayad frontend state sirf pehli baar set ho raha hai aur baad ke SSE events pe update nahi ho raha.
Suspected area: Jahan bhi 'heal X/2' chip render hota hai (Loop status bar component) — check karo woh kis event/state pe subscribe hai vs jahan se actual retry count aata hai (self_healing_router.py ya jahan bhi self-heal attempt counter maintain hota hai backend mein).
Priority: Medium
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Inspected the uncommitted ChatPanel.jsx fix, LoopStepBar.jsx rendering, backend _narrate event shape, and ran focused Vitest coverage. Then logged into preview and verified the user-visible pill behavior with a frontend-only synthetic SSE UI test: fresh kickoff hid data-testid="loop-retry-pill", two verify-danger 'Verify failed after 2 attempts' narration events updated it to '2/3 retries' (not stale 'heal 1/2'), and a second fresh kickoff reset it hidden. The preview login/dashboard were real; loop start/stream were MOCKED synthetic SSE to isolate the frontend state-sync bug as requested.
action_items: No fix action required for the reported frontend stale retry-pill symptom. Optional: run a full real LoopEngine verify-failure scenario later if backend/GitHub execution cost and setup are acceptable.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatPanel.jsx now increments loopVerifyRetryCount on every SSE narration where type='narration', narration_step='verify', tone='danger', and text/message matches /verify failed after \d+ attempts/i.
LoopStepBar.jsx prioritizes verifyRetryCount > 0 and renders '<N>/3 retries', so it no longer falls back to stale inner 'heal 1/2' after repeated outer verify failures.
backend/services/loop_engine.py _narrate emits message plus data.narration_text with the matching 'Verify failed after 2 attempts' text, so the frontend handler matches the real backend event shape.

success_rate.backend: N/A - frontend-only verification; backend code shape inspected

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Preview chat received two QA messages during the focused UI test; loop APIs were MOCKED in the browser route layer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use data-testid="loop-retry-pill" on /dashboard. The focused runtime proof used real login plus MOCKED /api/aurem-dev/loop/start and /loop/*/stream to inject two backend-shaped verify-danger narration frames; a real full LoopEngine run was not executed.
rca_of_the_issue: The stale UI was caused by loopVerifyRetryCount only mirroring verify_retry_count from paused_for_user paths, while automatic outer verify-failure cycles emitted narration events without updating that state. The fix increments the outer retry counter from each terminal verify-danger narration and resets it at fresh loop kickoff.
